data.narrative:
DroneShield operates in the Defense & Security sector as a public company with over $100M in cumulative capital raised. The comparable universe spans 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies, including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. However, the peer set presents a material constraint: within the Defense & Security sector, only 1 same-stage comparable exists, with zero adjacent-stage and zero similar-tier peers, falling well short of the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable peer-median triangulation.

The peer-median methodology is therefore inapplicable. The broader Defense & Security universe includes 21 peers, but applying all-sector medians would introduce substantial heterogeneity across valuation multiples, growth profiles, and business models—rendering such an approach misleading. Without sufficient narrow-filter comparables, traditional multiples-based triangulation cannot be reliably executed.

A full valuation range cannot be responsibly established from the data provided. Executing a defensible analysis would require either: (1) identifying additional same-stage or adjacent-stage Defense & Security peers to reach a minimum comparable set, (2) applying alternative methods (DCF or precedent transaction analysis) with explicit sensitivity analysis, or (3) acknowledging that the public market price of DRSHF, if available, serves as the most direct observable value proxy. The current data set is insufficient for triangulation.
